text:
miriam: Heads-up — seeing an edge-case in private-edge installs: keystore-proxy outgoing flows to customer KMS are intermittently dropped by netpols. cc @raj @jen :thinking:
raj: saw the same in canary logs last night. eBPF guard shows conntrack reject around SNATed ephemeral ports. link: https://logs/internal/5201
jen: is that our keystore talking externally or the cloud HSM bridge? thought the keystore was local in all cases
miriam: In some onprem topologies the keystore sidecar proxies to an external HSM bridge (customer opt-in). Our netpol only allowed src port 8443->dst 443, but replies use ephemeral ports so conntrack gets confused. we need a safer policy than wide 0.0.0.0/0 egress.
dave: Related question: last week's RBAC change added keystore-operator. did we accidentally give too-broad perms? saw a chart diff that worried me
raj: digging in — helm template had an accidental clusterrolebinding to 'system:masters' on one path (overlay bug). rolling that chart back now, will push fix.
miriam: We should rotate any keys that could have been touched just in case. audit logs currently show no unexpected decrypt/wrap calls but we should be proactive.
jen: How do we rotate for airgapped customers? we can't call cloud KMS to rewrap.
miriam: Plan: generate ephemeral KEK locally, rewrap DEKs and produce signed bundle for onprem operator to apply. will add runbook steps. also add a flag to avoid auto-rotate during canary upgrades.
dave: On vuln triage — openssl CVE-2025-XXXX found in sidecar base image. patch exists in base image 1.2.3. we should push patched image and force rolling upgrade. any blockers?
raj: pushing patched image tomorrow AM. canary 5% -> 100%. will include --no-auto-rotate flag so we don't trigger mass key churn.
miriam: Audit logging note: for private deployments we buffer and ship logs (S3 or local archive). we need integrity proofs for airgapped installs — suggest signed log segments (ed25519) + sequence numbers and offline verification.
jen: agreed. also add periodic merkle-root publication when the console regains connectivity. for fully-airgapped, the signing key lives in local HSM/KMS plugin.
dave: Incident runbook items to include: 1) isolate host (network-level), 2) revoke service certs, 3) emergency keystore operator run to rotate DEKs, 4) customer notification template + SOC steps. we need Slack incident channel pre-created.
miriam: I'll draft the runbook and tabletop checklist. Action items: @raj fix helm bug + rollback (owner: raj). @jen add signed-log changes to forwarder (owner: jen). @dave schedule tabletop + invite SOC/SE (owner: dave). I'll open PR for runbook.
raj: Ack — rolling back chart now, will post status here when done.
jen: Working on forwarder patch, ETA EOD. adding ed25519 signing support and sequence header.
dave: :thumbsup: tabletop set for Thu 11am PT. I'll create calendar invite and incident channel.
miriam: RBAC minimization proposal: keystore-reader (get/list), keystore-writer (wrap/unwrap), keystore-operator (rotate/manage). enforce separation: no single role gets both wrap and rotate. PR incoming.
audit-bot: Audit notice — no anomalous wrap/unwrap calls in last 30 days. chart change triggered 1 failed auth attempt at 5201234568 by 'helm-release'.
miriam: Nice catch @audit-bot. thanks. let's regroup after rollbacks and patches land.
raj: rotation command for onprem (manual):
```
./keystorectl rotate --local --inplace --signer /var/lib/keystore/hsm-slot0
```
use only after rollback is confirmed.
jen: i'll add that to runbook as a step with caveats.
dave: will run tabletop script and simulate revocation + rotation path. want to test roll-forward and rollback.
miriam: Great. Closing for now, will post PR + runbook link when ready.
